# Validation findings reference

Every finding emitted by `mztab-m` carries a stable code (`MZT-S*`, `MZT-T*`, or `MZT-X*`), a default severity derived from the rule's RFC 2119 requirement level (`MUST` -> `error`, `SHOULD` -> `warning`, `MAY` -> `info`; a few codes vary by rule or context, noted in the table), a source location, and a link to the specification section at pinned commit [`e66c19e`](https://github.com/HUPO-PSI/mzTab-M/tree/e66c19e1d5c2e61cd721cb3bd6134389184cf778) (target draft `2.1.0-M`).

Codes are never reused or renumbered. Severities can be overridden or disabled per code with `--severity CODE=error|warning|info|off` in the CLI or `validate::Config` in Rust.

This page is generated directly from `mztab_m::Code::ALL` (`crates/mztab-m/src/diag/code.rs`). CI fails if it drifts out of sync.
